import numpy as np

def deutsch_jozsa_circuit():
    qr = QuantumRegister(4, 'q')
    cr = ClassicalRegister(2, 'c')
    circuit = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

    # Initialize the last qubit in |1>
    circuit.ry(np.pi, qr[3])

        circuit.h(qr[i])

    # Use a single CNOT from qubit 0 to the ancilla as the oracle

    # Apply Hadamards to qubits 0 and 1 and measure those two qubits into classical bits 0 and 1
    circuit.h(qr[0])
    circuit.h(qr[1])
    circuit.measure(qr[0], cr[0])
    circuit.measure(qr[1], cr[1])

    return circuit
